## Scale accounting

The 70 legacy census slices remain searchable in `CIRCUITS_INDEX.md`, but they do not enter the evidential-circuit count until they receive a task-defined causal variable, multiple valid counterfactual families, held-out splits, causal interventions, selectivity controls, and a canonical v2 record.
